senses.meaning: Cay (thức ăn); (nghĩa bóng) kịch tính, thú vị, có chút xì-căng-đan
examples: The Thai green curry was incredibly spicy.
She always prefers spicy food to mild dishes.
The tabloid ran a spicy story about the celebrity couple.

senses.meaning: Chua (vị); khó tính, cáu kỉnh; (sữa) đã chua/hỏng
examples: The lemon juice made her face scrunch with its sour taste.
The milk has gone sour — don't drink it.
He became sour and bitter after losing the election.

senses.meaning: Trở nên chua; (quan hệ) xấu đi
examples: The wine soured in the warm storage room.
Their friendship soured after the argument.
Relations between the two countries have soured in recent months.

senses.meaning: Thuộc về ẩm thực, nấu nướng
examples: France is famous for its rich culinary traditions.
She attended a prestigious culinary school in Paris.
He has an impressive culinary background and trained under a Michelin-starred chef.

senses.meaning: Hạt, ngũ cốc; thớ gỗ; lượng rất nhỏ
examples: Wheat and rice are the most widely consumed grains in the world.
Cut the wood against the grain for a smoother finish.
There's not a grain of truth in what he said.

note: 'A grain of salt/truth' = một chút muối/sự thật (thường dùng trong 'take with a grain of salt' = nghi ngờ điều gì đó).

senses.meaning: Gia vị (thảo mộc/hạt dùng cho hương vị); sự thú vị thêm vào
examples: Cinnamon and cardamom are warm, aromatic spices.
The dish needs more spice to enhance its flavour.
Variety is the spice of life.

senses.meaning: Thêm gia vị; làm thú vị, hấp dẫn hơn
examples: She spiced the curry paste with fresh red chillies.
Spice up your routine by trying something new each week.
He spiced his speech with amusing anecdotes from his travels.

senses.meaning: Ninh nhỏ lửa (sôi nhẹ, không sôi sùng sục); sôi sục âm ỉ bên trong
examples: Let the soup simmer for thirty minutes on the lowest heat setting.
He was simmering with rage but kept his composure throughout.
Tensions simmered for months before the conflict finally erupted.

senses.meaning: Dầu mỡ động vật; chất bôi trơn
examples: She wiped the cooking grease from her hands after frying.
The mechanic applied grease to the engine components.
The pan was covered in a thick layer of grease.

senses.meaning: Bôi mỡ, phết dầu (dụng cụ nấu ăn); bôi trơn
examples: Grease the tin lightly with butter before pouring in the batter.
He greased the squeaky hinge with oil.
'Grease someone's palm' means to offer a bribe.

senses.meaning: Món hầm, món ninh (thịt/rau ninh lâu với nước)
examples: She made a hearty beef stew for dinner on a cold evening.
Irish stew is traditionally made with lamb, potatoes, and vegetables.
The stew was left on the stove to cook all afternoon.

senses.meaning: Hầm, ninh (thức ăn); lo lắng âm thầm
examples: Stew the meat on very low heat for at least two hours.
He stewed in his own anger for days after the argument.
Don't stew over it — just move on.

senses.meaning: Bánh mì nướng; lời chúc mừng khi nâng ly
examples: She had toast with jam and a cup of tea for breakfast.
The best man proposed a toast to the bride and groom.
Let's raise a toast to the project's success.

senses.meaning: Nướng (bánh mì, hạt...); nâng ly chúc mừng
examples: Toast the bread until it is golden brown and crispy.
They toasted the new year with champagne at midnight.
Everyone raised their glasses and toasted the couple's health.

senses.meaning: Đồ uống (formal)
examples: Please choose a hot or cold beverage from the menu.
The café serves a wide range of beverages.
Alcoholic beverages are not served before noon at this venue.

note: Formal. Trong giao tiếp thông thường chỉ cần dùng 'drink'.

senses.meaning: Bữa trưa trang trọng (thường trong sự kiện chính thức)
examples: The mayor hosted a luncheon for visiting foreign dignitaries.
The charity luncheon raised significant funds for the hospital.
She wore a smart suit to the business luncheon at the hotel.

note: Formal/somewhat old-fashioned. Trong giao tiếp thông thường dùng 'lunch'.

senses.meaning: Vỏ bánh mì (phần ngoài giòn); lớp vỏ cứng bên ngoài
examples: She always cuts the crust off her sandwiches.
The apple pie had a beautiful golden, flaky crust.
A thin crust of ice formed overnight on the puddles.

note: 'The upper crust' (idiom) = tầng lớp thượng lưu.

senses.meaning: Quá trình lên men (vi khuẩn/nấm men chuyển hóa đường thành rượu, axit, hoặc khí)
examples: Fermentation is the process that turns grape juice into wine.
The bread rises during baking because of fermentation from the yeast.
Fermentation is used in the production of cheese, beer, yogurt, and soy sauce.

senses.meaning: Ale — loại bia nồng, ủ với men lên men trên bề mặt (khác với lager)
examples: He ordered a pint of pale ale at the local pub.
Real ale is traditionally brewed without artificial additives.
British ales vary widely in colour, strength, and flavour.

note: Khác với 'lager' (bia vàng nhạt ủ lạnh): ale có vị đậm, nồng, ủ ở nhiệt độ cao hơn.

senses.meaning: Tiệc nướng ngoài trời; vỉ nướng; đồ ăn nướng
examples: They hosted a barbecue in the garden on a sunny Sunday afternoon.
Put the chicken on the barbecue when the coals are hot and ready.
BBQ sauce is the barbecue's most essential condiment.

senses.meaning: Nướng trên vỉ ngoài trời
examples: We barbecued steaks and corn for the whole family.
She barbecued the whole fish with lemon, herbs, and olive oil.
It's perfect weather to barbecue in the backyard.

senses.meaning: Thịt hươu, thịt nai
examples: Venison has a rich, slightly gamey flavour.
The restaurant's signature dish is slow-cooked venison with red wine sauce.
Venison steaks were served at the hunting lodge after the weekend hunt.

note: 'Game meat' = thịt thú săn. Venison là loại game meat phổ biến nhất ở Anh và Scotland.

senses.meaning: Trứng bác, trứng khuấy
examples: Scrambled eggs on toast is a classic British breakfast.
He made fluffy scrambled eggs with cream, butter, and chives.
The hotel buffet included scrambled eggs, bacon, and grilled tomatoes.

senses.meaning: Ngũ cốc ăn sáng (ăn với sữa); cây ngũ cốc (lúa mì, gạo, ngô...)
examples: She eats a bowl of cereal with cold milk every morning.
Wheat, rice, and maize are the world's most important cereal crops.
The supermarket shelf was lined with colourful cereal boxes.

senses.meaning: Bảo quản lạnh, để vào tủ lạnh
examples: Refrigerate any leftover cooked chicken within two hours.
This product must be refrigerated after opening.
The medication needs to be refrigerated at all times.

senses.meaning: Vỉ nướng; món nướng trên vỉ
examples: Put the steak on a hot grill for five minutes on each side.
She cooked the vegetables on a cast-iron grill pan.
The restaurant is renowned for its wood-fired grill dishes.

senses.meaning: Nướng trên vỉ (không dầu); (informal) thẩm vấn gắt gao
examples: Grill the chicken until the juices run clear.
The prosecutor grilled the witness for over two hours.
The interviewers really grilled him about his previous experience.

note: 'Grill' trong tiếng Anh Anh = nướng từ trên (broiler); trong tiếng Anh Mỹ thường là nướng từ dưới (barbecue).

senses.meaning: Muỗng múc lớn; một phần kem; tin độc quyền (báo chí)
examples: She served two scoops of vanilla ice cream in a bowl.
The reporter got the scoop on the election result before anyone else.
Use a scoop to transfer flour from the bag to the mixing bowl.

senses.meaning: Múc, xúc; đào lấy; giành tin độc quyền
examples: Scoop the seeds out of the pumpkin before roasting it.
She scooped the laughing child up into her arms.
The newspaper scooped all rivals with the breaking story.

senses.meaning: Đồ xay nhuyễn, đồ nghiền mịn
examples: Add a tablespoon of tomato puree for a richer sauce.
The baby was given a diet of smooth vegetable purees.
Pea puree is a popular accompaniment to pan-fried fish.

senses.meaning: Xay nhuyễn, nghiền đến mịn
examples: Puree the soup in a blender until completely smooth.
She pureed the carrots, then mixed them with butter and cream.
Puree the mango and freeze in moulds for ice lollies.

senses.meaning: Nước chấm, sốt chấm; sự sụt giảm ngắn; bài bơi ngắn
examples: The platter came with three dips — hummus, salsa, and guacamole.
There's been a dip in sales this quarter.
She went for a quick dip in the pool before breakfast.

senses.meaning: Nhúng, chấm (vào nước chấm); giảm xuống ngắn hạn
examples: Dip the bread into the olive oil and balsamic vinegar.
She dipped her toes in the cold lake water.
Temperatures dipped below zero overnight.

senses.meaning: Nghiền nát, tán nhuyễn (thức ăn)
examples: Mash the potatoes with butter and cream until silky smooth.
She mashed the avocado with lime juice to make guacamole.
He mashed the garlic into a paste with the flat of a knife.

note: 'Mash' (n) = khoai tây nghiền (mashed potato) — món ăn kèm phổ biến ở Anh.

senses.meaning: Băm, thái, chặt (thức ăn hoặc gỗ)
examples: Chop the onions finely before adding them to the pan.
He chopped firewood to prepare for winter.
The funding for the project was chopped due to budget constraints.

note: 'Chop and change' (idiom) = thay đổi liên tục, không nhất quán.

senses.meaning: Miếng thịt tẩm bột chiên; cục vàng; thông tin/sự thật quý giá nhỏ
examples: The kids ordered chicken nuggets and chips for dinner.
Gold nuggets were found by prospectors during the California Gold Rush.
That article contains a few nuggets of genuinely useful information.
